notes.title: Auver Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Below are all the new things and bug fixes in Auver 1.2.

Optimization

This is probably the biggest change in this update. I've optimized every single level in the game as much as possible, so you will now experience up to 30 extra fps.


Graphics Updates

Improved lighting!
More environmental details!
Enhanced materials!
I will stop using exclamation marks after this line!


Additional New Stuff

DLSS Support for RTX cards.
Enhanced controller support (the game is still not fully playable with just a controller).


Bug Fixes

The game is no longer a buggy mess (more details below).
The UI has been reworked behind the scenes, so buttons are less likely to unfocus now.
No errors in game settings when no game has been saved yet.


This may be the final update for Auver, as I have other future projects upcoming.

notes.title: Auver 1.1 Update is live!
notes.notes:
This update contains smaller bug fixes, additions, and optimizations in the game.
Here's the list of updates:

- Added additional UI for controls
- Removed unused LODs in forest
- Fixed grass and tree positions in forest
- Puppet animation stops after chase in office
- Optimized crow feathers
- Optimized escalators
- Optimized 3D models
